verdict.rationale: Titan Security Key is a hardware FIDO authenticator that verifies sign-ins and key integrity. It is not a service that collects user content, so an opt-out from AI training is outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows it handles user data in a way that could feed model training, so this axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
